significance: The Divya Desam of Tirucherai near Kumbakonam, unusual in giving Vishnu five consorts and in housing a shrine to the river goddess Kaveri; Chola inscriptions of the 10th century record endowments.
story: Vishnu is said to have appeared as a child to the goddess Kaveri here to test her devotion, then granted her rank equal to the Ganga.
